name: Vanderbilt Hospital

decisions: Metro has 6 footprints here where OSM has one; compared against their union, OSM kept as one building (roof parts split it)
OSM and Metro differ (corner p95 20.48 m); Metro is closer to the LiDAR edge (0.59 vs 0.78 m): Metro used
LiDAR roof edge lies a uniform 0.50 m outside the walls: logged as roof overhang, not corrected
3 edge(s) more than 0.3 m off the LiDAR edge moved to it: 5.34 m edge inward 0.59 m; 9.03 m edge inward 0.66 m; 43.06 m edge outward 0.43 m

material_rule: walls and vertical roof steps brick_red (guess); roof faces flatter than 6 deg roof_flat, steeper roof_slate unless the Metro 2026 ortho color is clearly green (roof_copper) or orange-red (roof_tile); base concrete

collider.kind: one non-convex static triangle mesh (LoD2 shell without base cap)
problems: an edge used twice in the same direction (inconsistent winding)

accuracy.reason: P2 (pitched, 602 m2): eave -0.05 m, ridge +0.82 m, 100% of roof points within 0.5 m; P3 (pitched, 517 m2): eave -0.31 m, ridge +0.05 m, 96% of roof points within 0.5 m; P4 (curved, 364 m2): eave -0.00 m, ridge +0.34 m, 100% of roof points within 0.5 m; ... 11 more parts over 0.2 m

footprint.reference: metro outline; LiDAR edge for moved corners
